ov: About 90 species of small songbirds built for catching insects in the air, with long, pointed wings and often forked tails. The barn swallow, with blue upperparts and a red face, is the most widespread swallow in the world.
rg: Every continent; barn swallows even turn up in Antarctica as vagrants.
fx: Barn swallows from across Eurasia winter in southern Africa and tend to return to the same wintering spot each year.
The barn swallow is the national bird of Austria and Estonia.
